title: Review
body:
Today I am reviewing Habit Minder. I was so angry and wanted to organise and add to my productive folder on my IPad Pro 2021’s Home Screen. I kept scrolling down through apps for a long time until I found a couple of sections labelled Health, Education, Entertainment, Productivity, etc. I went in Productivity and found this. And lemme tell y’all, this didn’t make my life upside down, but downside up, by which I mean that it did not effect my life in a negative way, but in such a way, that I call positive, that made me so engulfed and happy the way I am, the way I have been created. It relaxes my mental peace to see all of my statistics and goals at large with no sign of dripping down through any hole, visible or invisible. 🕳 I feel like my life has taken a fresher start than before. Great things take time. Sometimes they take a minute, sometimes they take years. I wonder, maybe if I found this app ten years ago, when I did not have an IPad, or ten years to the future, when I do not know what I will own. 

I feel grateful to have found this, I thank the app developers a million for creating an app, that can straighten the life of a person who found their app via randomly scrolling through their App Store.
author: Snuggly Poodle
